creatures.name: Leviathan
creatures.description: A colossal sea serpent of biblical legend, basically the ocean's version of a boss fight.

creatures.name: Satyr
creatures.description: Half-man, half-goat, full-time party animal with a penchant for pan flutes and poor decisions.

creatures.name: Nymph
creatures.description: Nature spirits that embody the beauty of forests, rivers, and fields—like Mother Nature’s influencers.

creatures.name: Anansi
creatures.description: A clever spider-trickster from African folklore who spins both webs and stories.

creatures.name: Troll
creatures.description: Grumpy bridge-dwellers or mountain giants with questionable hygiene and zero social skills.

creatures.name: Bunyip
creatures.description: A mysterious Australian swamp creature—think cryptid meets cautionary tale.

creatures.name: Iktomi
creatures.description: A Lakota spider-trickster god who weaves chaos with intelligence and mischief.

creatures.name: Loch Ness Monster
creatures.description: Scotland’s most elusive lake dweller—photogenic, yet camera shy.

creatures.name: Chupacabra
creatures.description: The goat-sucker of Latin American lore, feared by livestock and embraced by late-night TV.

creatures.name: Jackalope
creatures.description: A mythical horned rabbit—equal parts adorable and armed.

creatures.name: Phoenix
creatures.description: A firebird that bursts into flames and rises from the ashes. Ultimate glow-up.

creatures.name: Griffin
creatures.description: The majestic fusion of lion and eagle—basically nature's power couple.

creatures.name: Minotaur
creatures.description: Bull-headed maze dweller with anger management issues.

creatures.name: Dragon
creatures.description: Winged, fire-breathing legends found in nearly every culture—mythology’s most iconic hothead.

creatures.name: Unicorn
creatures.description: A magical horse with a horn and a brand deal with rainbows.

creatures.name: Cerberus
creatures.description: The three-headed hound guarding the gates of the Underworld—think security with bite.

creatures.name: Hydra
creatures.description: Cut off one head, two more grow—medieval multitasking nightmare.

creatures.name: Cyclops
creatures.description: A one-eyed giant with a terrible depth perception and worse manners.

creatures.name: Chimera
creatures.description: A fiery mashup of lion, goat, and snake—ancient Greece's version of a patch update gone rogue.

creatures.name: Sphinx
creatures.description: Riddle-loving guardian with the body of a lion and the face of a trivia night champion.

creatures.name: Kraken
creatures.description: Giant sea monster with a flair for dramatic ship-smashing entrances.

creatures.name: Banshee
creatures.description: A wailing Irish spirit—when she screams, someone’s about to get ghosted. Literally.

creatures.name: Centaur
creatures.description: Half-man, half-horse, all gallop. Known for archery and identity confusion.

creatures.name: Pegasus
creatures.description: A winged horse who makes a dramatic entrance look like child's play.

creatures.name: Basilisk
creatures.description: Deadly reptile that can kill with a glare—basically a toxic gaze personified.

creatures.name: Gorgon
creatures.description: Snake-haired women whose gaze turns folks to stone. Zero tolerance for awkward stares.

creatures.name: Harpy
creatures.description: Winged women of vengeance and shrieking doom. Not your ideal dinner guests.

creatures.name: Siren
creatures.description: Sea-dwelling singers whose songs spell doom. Basically ancient Spotify with bad intentions.

creatures.name: Djinn
creatures.description: Magical beings with big powers and even bigger fine print.

creatures.name: Kitsune
creatures.description: Shapeshifting fox spirit of Japanese lore, equally known for wisdom and mischief.

creatures.name: Wendigo
creatures.description: Cannibal spirit of the frozen north, driven by hunger and spooky winter vibes.

creatures.name: Kappa
creatures.description: A polite yet dangerous river creature from Japan—just bow back and you’ll be fine.

creatures.name: Rusalka
creatures.description: Slavic water spirit with a haunting beauty and ghost story energy.

creatures.name: Naga
creatures.description: Serpent beings from Hindu and Buddhist mythology—divine and deadly.

creatures.name: Valkyrie
creatures.description: Norse warrior-maidens who choose the slain—Valkyrie Uber to Valhalla.

creatures.name: Thunderbird
creatures.description: Giant bird of Native American lore that brings the storm—and the thunder.

creatures.name: Manticore
creatures.description: Lion body, scorpion tail, human face—nature’s uncanny collage.

creatures.name: Selkie
creatures.description: Seal by sea, human by shore—romantic shapeshifters with trust issues.

creatures.name: Yeti
creatures.description: Himalayan snow monster. Cold, elusive, and probably tired of the paparazzi.

creatures.name: Upyr
creatures.description: A Slavic vampire who snacks during the day. A real overachiever in the undead community.

creatures.name: Chort
creatures.description: A demon of Slavic folklore—goat horns, evil laugh, and chaotic energy.

creatures.name: Polyovyk
creatures.description: Field spirit of Slavic myth, more at home in wheat than your average scarecrow.

creatures.name: Poludnytsya
creatures.description: The ‘Lady Midday’ who appears in fields to strike down lazy workers. Your HR department's nightmare.

creatures.name: Povitruya
creatures.description: Slavic air spirit with a breezy attitude and a twist of mischief.

creatures.name: Mavka
creatures.description: Forest nymphs with tragic origins and a haunting gaze. Think enchanted ghost, not Casper.

creatures.name: Vodyanoy
creatures.description: Slavic water spirit with a grudge and a tendency to drown fishermen. Hydration with consequences.

creatures.name: Vodyanitsa
creatures.description: Female counterpart to the Vodyanoy, equally mysterious and equally fond of ponds.

creatures.name: Domovik
creatures.description: Household spirit from Slavic folklore. Part ghost, part roommate, all vibes.

creatures.name: Baba Yaga
creatures.description: Witch of the woods who flies in a mortar and pestle—your grandma if she were an eldritch boss.

creatures.name: Leshy
creatures.description: Forest guardian with a talent for leading travelers astray and sprouting from trees.
